name: c02-godown-lakshmi
prompt: Exactly as in the image: inside a distributor's godown, tall racks of plain kraft cartons with a sage-green band on both sides, a shaft of sun from the barred window, dust in the light. The woman in the deep teal saree with the long grey-streaked plait and the glasses on a cord holds an open carton of small yellow-orange mango drink tetra packs. She lifts the glasses onto her nose, turns the carton a little to read the date on its side, frowns, then lowers it and looks up the aisle with quiet concern, breathing out. A slow push in on her. Sound: a ceiling fan's hum, cardboard creaking, distant traffic and a bicycle bell from the lane. No text, no logos, no lettering anywhere. Photorealistic live action, 35 mm, natural skin and fabric.
use: SC-158: one shot of the demo film, image to video from its keyframe
